lockedFacts: comparison iterates variables from the first file and looks up the same variable in the second file
when control is the first file, extra variables present only in the instrumented second file are not part of the comparison traversal
the locked HRRRv4 copy enters field-value comparison only for WRF_REAL variables
the locked comparator checks matching time strings, dimensions, WRF type and real-valued field contents for traversed variables
the locked comparator does not provide a complete allowlisted added-variable manifest or a full shared-attribute/schema equality contract
limits: this is an engineering comparison tool, not an atmospheric Observation Root
a diffwrf pass alone does not prove equality of skipped integer/string state, all metadata, exact added-variable set, or all dataset-manifest properties

lockedFacts: the inspected current upstream comparator handles WRF_REAL and WRF_INTEGER value comparison
comparison-tool behavior therefore changes across source generations and must itself be version-locked
limits: current upstream WRF comparator behavior cannot be silently substituted for the locked HRRRv4 tool when claiming HRRRv4 validation identity

lockedFacts: WRF officially uses paired output runs and diffwrf for bit-wise reproducibility checks
when differences occur, the documented debugging method is to increase output frequency and locate the first differing variable/time
limits: official use of diffwrf does not imply that the locked HRRRv4 copy validates instrumentation-specific schema and metadata conditions that its source does not check

derivedExecutableEvidence.scope: semantic comparator contract only; no WRF or HRRR execution and no atmospheric truth values

externalAI.policy: candidate interpretation only; no external AI output is an Observation Root
